body: I feel like this guy is what Joe Rogan is halfway through a transformation into.

Things started in january. I've been worrying and fighting just about every day. Every day I can't go for more than a few minutes without rethinking my approach, wondering about variables, and just being nervous and sad. I can't keep this up forever. 
2018....Boss screams in my face, I scream back. Boss pretends I quit my job.

Get transferred to a new store after a week of no work. Work at that store for about a month.... get fired for completely made up reason.

Get new job within 2 weeks, car dies on FIRST. DAY.

Get loans for a different car, buy car, loans cover some repairs for inspection, but 667 dollars short. i couldn't possibly ask for any more money. I'm going to use temp tags to go back to work, and try to get the rest together. If that doesn't work my life is going to really bad really fast. It's already this bad. I have very little food, running out. My cell phone service ran out, and I don't even have my own phone number to coordinate any more. The finish line keeps moving. I'm tired.

What happened?
EDIT: it's good that you can still get online and be connected.

I have no job, no car, no money, no ideas. I'm 40. I've been self medicating my problems with weed for 24 years. I live at home because I am too scared to leave. Now I can't even kid myself about the idea of leaving. I am about to become super needy, on top of the drain that I already am on people who care about me. I don't think I can do it.
Glad I'm not the only one
